feed.title: AwesomeCUA: newly reviewed resources
feed.subtitle: Computer-use agent papers, models, datasets, benchmarks and tools as they pass source review, newest review first. Metadata-only bibliography records and unreviewed candidates are not included.
feed.rights: Catalog annotations: MIT. Linked resources keep their own terms.

entry.title: "What Did It Actually Do?": Understanding Risk Awareness and Traceability for Computer-Use Agents
entry.summary: Presents an interview study of computer-use agent risks and AgentTrace, a prototype interface showing agent actions, resource access, permission history, and lasting changes.

entry.title: A Benchmark and Framework for Evaluating Next Action Predictions in Spreadsheets
entry.summary: Introduces a benchmark and online evaluation method for predicting the next spreadsheet action from a user's action history, using curated action sequences.

entry.title: A Decade in a Day: Synthesizing Agent-Native Interfaces from Human-Oriented Software Evolution
entry.summary: Introduces DeskIF-Bench to study how desktop application interfaces affect agents, and ANIS to synthesize interfaces from installed application capabilities.

entry.title: A Task-State Representation for Long-Horizon Mobile GUI Agents
entry.summary: Introduces TSR, a training-free wrapper for long-horizon mobile GUI agents that tracks instructions, subgoal progress, and action outcomes separately from screen observations.

entry.title: AcademiClaw: When Students Set Challenges for AI Agents
entry.summary: AcademiClaw benchmarks OpenClaw agents on long academic workflows, scoring task completion in isolated Docker sandboxes with rubrics and a safety audit.

entry.title: Activity Frames: Deterministic Screen-Activity Compilation for Agent Memory and Replay
entry.summary: Introduces Activity Frames, a deterministic pipeline that turns captured screen activity into typed episodes for computer-use agent memory and routine replay.

entry.title: AdaGround: Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming with Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement for GUI Grounding
entry.summary: Introduces AdaGround, a training-free GUI grounding method that adjusts screenshot zoom to target size and uses a click verifier to refine or reject predictions.

entry.title: Affora: A Design System for Agent-Friendly Interfaces
entry.summary: Presents Affora, a design system with reusable components and executable checks for interfaces used by computer-use agents, informed by studies of components and visual variation.

entry.title: Agent MechSuits: Mechanistic Subspace Safety Steering for Multi-Turn CLI Agents
entry.summary: Introduces Agent MechSuits, a framework that detects unsafe states and steers multi-turn CLI agents through hidden-representation interventions, alongside the MAS trajectory benchmark.

entry.title: AgentHazard: A Benchmark for Evaluating Harmful Behavior in Computer-Use Agents
entry.summary: Introduces AgentHazard, a benchmark of harmful multi-step behavior by computer-use agents acting through tools, files, and execution environments.

entry.title: AgentHeal: Evaluating Goal-Preserving Resource Recovery of Web Agents under Access Barriers
entry.summary: Introduces AgentHeal, a benchmark of whether web agents detect access barriers, find legitimate alternative sources, and preserve the user's original goal.

entry.title: AgentHijack: Benchmarking Computer Use Agent Robustness to Common Environment Corruptions
entry.summary: Introduces AgentHijack, a benchmark for desktop computer-use agents facing pop-ups, resolution changes and other common corruptions, alongside an agent that checks its environment.

entry.title: Agentic Compilation: Mitigating the LLM Rerun Crisis for Minimized-Inference-Cost Web Automation
entry.summary: Proposes Compile-and-Execute, which turns a sanitized DOM into a reusable JSON workflow so repetitive browser tasks can run without further model queries.

entry.title: Agentic Critical Training
entry.summary: Introduces Agentic Critical Training (ACT), a reinforcement-learning warm-up that teaches general agents to choose expert actions over alternatives, with WebShop among its evaluations.

entry.title: Agentic ESOpt: Fine-Tuning Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Minimal GPU Requirements
entry.summary: Introduces Agentic ESOpt, an evolution-strategies fine-tuning framework for long-horizon agents, evaluated on WebArena-Lite web tasks and automatic heuristic design.

entry.title: Agentic World Modeling: Foundations, Capabilities, Laws, and Beyond
entry.summary: Survey of agentic world models that classifies predictive capabilities and governing laws, including the digital setting of web and GUI agents.

entry.title: AgentLens: Adaptive Visual Modalities for Human-Agent Interaction in Mobile GUI Agents
entry.summary: Introduces AgentLens, a mobile GUI agent that shows full, partial, or generated interface views during background task execution to support user interaction.

entry.title: AgentOS: From Application Silos to a Natural Language-Driven Data Ecosystem
entry.summary: Proposes Personal Agent Operating System (AgentOS), with a natural language or voice portal and an Agent Kernel that coordinates agents and tasks in place of a GUI desktop.

entry.title: AgentProofBench: Benchmarking Reusable Verifiers for Web Agents
entry.summary: Introduces AgentProofBench, a benchmark linking tests of reusable web-agent verification rules to subsequent execution from saved web states.

entry.title: AgentShield: Fortifying Web Applications Against AI Agents and Agentic Browsers
entry.summary: Evaluates agentic browsers against web anti-bot defenses and introduces AgentShield, a behavioral fingerprinting framework for distinguishing agents from people.

entry.title: AgentVQA: A Unified Benchmark for Agentic Visual Understanding
entry.summary: AgentVQA is an offline visual question-answering benchmark across five agent domains, including web agents and questions involving UI element location.

entry.title: AI Planning Framework for LLM-Based Web Agents
entry.summary: Introduces a planning taxonomy and trajectory-quality metrics for web agents, supported by 794 human-labeled WebArena trajectories and a comparison of two planning styles.

entry.title: Alignment Is Local: A Paired Diagnostic for GUI Agents under User-Side Persuasion
entry.summary: Presents a paired diagnostic of prompt guardrails in GUI agents under screen-grounded user persuasion, comparing single-turn probes with four-turn escalation.

entry.title: Anchor: Preventing Artifact Drift for Reliable Agent Verification
entry.summary: Anchor builds ERP-Bench by generating procurement and manufacturing tasks with shared state verifiers for evaluating browser and computer-use agents.

entry.title: AndroidFlux: Evaluating and Reward Modeling Failure Recovery Capabilities in Mobile Use Multimodal Agents
entry.summary: Introduces AndroidFlux, a mobile-agent failure-recovery benchmark that restores trajectories to error checkpoints, plus a reward-modeling benchmark and offline RL dataset.

entry.title: ANGLER: Verifier-Grounded Benchmarking with an Adaptive Attacker for Web Agents
entry.summary: Introduces REEF, a website benchmark with state-based attack verification, and ANGLER, which adapts attack lures using outcomes from web-agent rollouts.

entry.title: AOHP: An Open-Source OS-Level Agent Harness for Personalized, Efficient and Secure Interaction
entry.summary: Introduces AOHP, an Android OS-level harness that treats agents as system actors and provides adaptive interfaces, agent interfaces, and information-flow controls.

entry.title: AppAgent-Claw: CLI Is All You Need for GUI Automation
entry.summary: Introduces AppAgent-Claw, which records demonstrated GUI workflows as reusable OpenClaw skills, locates visual targets during replay and checks intended on-screen effects.

entry.title: AQuaUI: Visual Token Reduction for GUI Agents with Adaptive Quadtrees
entry.summary: AQuaUI reduces screenshot tokens for GUI agents at inference time with adaptive quadtrees that retain spatial positions and reuse prior tree structure across steps.

entry.title: Ares: Adaptive Reasoning Effort Selection for Efficient LLM Agents
entry.summary: Introduces Ares, a router that selects a reasoning level for each step of a general LLM agent from its interaction history, with web agents among the evaluation settings.

entry.title: Augmenting Interface Usability Heuristics for Reliable Computer-Use Agents
entry.summary: A study adapts interface usability heuristics for computer-use agents and evaluates augmented designs in UI-Verse, a suite of controlled interface environments.

entry.title: Automated Trajectory Evaluation for Mobile Agents via Step-Level Consequence Reasoning and Aggregation
entry.summary: Introduces CRATE, a step-level visual judge for mobile-agent trajectories, and CRATE-S for assessing operational safety from action-conditioned state changes.

entry.title: AutomationBench
entry.summary: Introduces AutomationBench, a benchmark for agents coordinating business workflows across applications through REST APIs, including endpoint discovery and policy adherence.

entry.title: Back to Basics: A Skill-Centric Approach to Generalist Web Agents
entry.summary: Introduces MiniWeb for skill-labeled browser tasks, MiniWebGen for generating training trajectories, and MiniWebAgent for composing learned skills into web workflows.

entry.title: Back to the Future: A workbook time machine for spread sheet creation benchmarks
entry.summary: Introduces the workbook time machine to create spreadsheet-object tasks and wtmbench to evaluate spreadsheet manipulation agents using different control interfaces.

entry.title: BAMI: Training-Free Bias Mitigation in GUI Grounding
entry.summary: BAMI uses coarse-to-fine focus and candidate selection at inference time to address precision and ambiguity errors in GUI grounding.

entry.title: BaRA: Budget-constrained and Reliable Web Data Collection Agent
entry.summary: Introduces BaRA, a web data-collection agent that discovers live site links, checks extracted text, images, and videos, and uses history to recover from failures.

entry.title: Benchmarking General Mobile Assistants in Challenging Real-World Scenarios
entry.summary: Introduces GMA, a benchmark of 300 mobile-assistant tasks across seven applications, and studies how agent context retention and state tracking affect complex workflows.

entry.title: Benchmarking Web Agent Safety under E-commerce Deceptive Interfaces
entry.summary: Introduces WebDecept, a plugin for injecting deceptive e-commerce interface patterns during web-agent tasks and evaluating how multimodal agents respond.

entry.title: Beyond Binary: Reframing GUI Critique as Continuous Semantic Alignment
entry.summary: BBCritic ranks candidate GUI-agent actions through instruction–action alignment, while BBBench evaluates fine-grained ranking with a hierarchical action taxonomy.

entry.title: Beyond Domains: Reusing Web Skills via Transferable Interaction Patterns
entry.summary: Introduces SkillMigrator, a web agent that turns successful interactions into reusable skills and transfers them between sites by matching page layouts and live element references.

entry.title: Beyond the Verdict: Evidence-Aligned Evaluation of Visual Prompt-Injection Guardrails
entry.summary: Introduces Mind2Web-Injection, a benchmark for evaluating web-agent guardrail decisions on instruction-screenshot pairs using evidence boxes and image-side counterfactuals.

entry.title: BlueFin: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Financial Spreadsheets
entry.summary: Introduces BlueFin, a benchmark and evaluation framework for agents handling professional finance spreadsheet workbooks through synthesis, manipulation, and comprehension tasks.

entry.title: BraveGuard: From Open-World Threats to Safer Computer-Use Agents
entry.summary: Introduces BraveGuard, a framework that turns emerging threats and computer-use agent trajectories into training supervision for guards that monitor multi-step safety risks.

entry.title: Bridging VideoQA and Video-Guided Agentic Tasks via Generalized Keyframe Extraction
entry.summary: Introduces VG-GUIBench to evaluate GUI agents following video tutorials, and TASKER to select task-relevant keyframes for video-guided tasks and VideoQA.

entry.title: Build or Adopt? Custom-Built vs. General-Purpose LLM Agent Harnesses for Automotive GUI Testing
entry.summary: Compares a custom harness with general-purpose LLM agent harnesses for GUI testing of Android-based vehicle interfaces and tasks in public apps.

entry.title: CA-OPD: Confidence-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Structured Visual Prediction
entry.summary: Introduces CA-OPD, a confidence-guided distillation method for visual prediction, evaluated on GUI grounding and optical character recognition benchmarks.

entry.title: Can LLM Agents Learn to Test? Maintaining Scoped Experience as Testing Evidence for Mobile GUI Testing
entry.summary: AdaptiTest specifies scoped, revalidated memory for an LLM-based mobile GUI tester to reuse routes and locators across read-only Android test workflows.

entry.title: CAPTCHA Solving for Native GUI Agents: Automated Reasoning-Action Data Generation and Self-Corrective Training
entry.summary: Introduces ReCAP, a native GUI agent for interactive CAPTCHA challenges, trained with generated interaction trajectories, reasoning traces and self-correction data.

entry.title: Chart the Invisible: Interactive Perception for Hidden-Target Exploration in GUI Agents
entry.summary: Introduces Hagasu, a scrollable-region perception model that helps GUI agents decide where to swipe to reveal hidden targets, especially on mobile screens.

entry.title: ChartAct: A Benchmark for Dynamic Chart Understanding
entry.summary: ChartAct benchmarks multimodal models and GUI agents on interactive charts from websites, requiring actions such as hovering or zooming to answer questions.

entry.title: ClawProBench: Trace-Aware Evaluation of AI Agents with Runtime Coverage and Frozen Workplace-Style Holdouts
entry.summary: Introduces ClawProBench, a trace-aware benchmark for agents on OpenClaw that scores workspace and native-runtime tasks using execution traces, safety checks, and process quality.

entry.title: Co-Design Bench: Multimodal Collaborative Coding Evaluation for Agentic Models
entry.summary: Introduces Co-Design Bench to evaluate coding agents that revise applications from multimodal user requests, including UI changes assessed with browser evidence.

entry.title: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents
entry.summary: Introduces CoPE, which trains language agents to forecast later actions from earlier histories during RL; WebShop is one of five evaluation benchmarks.

entry.title: CoAdapt-GUI: Joint Workflow Context and Policy Adaptation for Unseen GUI Applications
entry.summary: Introduces CoAdapt-GUI, which adapts workflow context and policy from a mobile GUI agent's own rollouts and rewards when it encounters unseen applications.

entry.title: CoArena: Evaluating Computer-Use and Multi-Agent Systems in Real Time
entry.summary: Introduces CoArena, an evaluation method where user tasks run concurrently in sandboxed desktops and blind pairwise judgments update a public leaderboard.

entry.title: Coati: Host-Grounded Execution for Installable Mobile GUI Agents
entry.summary: Introduces Coati, an installable Android GUI agent that checks action outcomes with phone-side evidence, stores per-app procedures, and routes simpler steps to a fast executor.

entry.title: CocoaBench: Evaluating Unified Digital Agents in the Wild
entry.summary: Introduces CocoaBench, a benchmark for unified digital agents on long-horizon tasks combining vision, search, and coding, including capabilities related to GUI automation.

entry.title: CoME: Empowering Channel-of-Mobile-Experts with Informative Hybrid-Capabilities Reasoning
entry.summary: Introduces Channel-of-Mobile-Experts (CoME), a mobile agent with experts for screen summary, subtask planning, action decisions and action functions, trained in stages with InfoGain-Driven DPO (Info-DPO).

entry.title: Computer Use at the Edge of the Statistical Precipice
entry.summary: DigiWorld is a sandboxed mobile-app benchmark for computer-use agents, paired with PRISM environment principles and a confidence-interval aggregation method.

entry.title: Computer-Use Agents Gain Little Benefit from a World Model When Conditioned on Tutorials
entry.summary: RAG-PolicyJudge selects computer-use actions proposed with task-specific tutorials; the study compares its decisions with and without world-model rollouts.

entry.title: Constraining Host-Level Abuse in Self-Hosted Computer-Use Agents via TEE-Backed Isolation
entry.summary: A TEE-backed design confines host operations by self-hosted computer-use agents, classifying and authorizing actions before constrained local execution.

entry.title: Context-Aware Workflow Decomposition for Automated Mobile UI Annotation Using Multimodal Large Language Models
entry.summary: Studies staged prompting for automated mobile UI element annotation, comparing workflow depths and element groupings on expert-annotated MUIAnno screens.

entry.title: Correct Answers, Closed Gates: SolveBind for GUI Agents at the Verification Barrier
entry.summary: Introduces SolveBind, a GUI-agent framework that decomposes verification tasks and uses runtime evidence to guide interactions with protected websites and applications.

entry.title: cotomi Act: Learning to Automate Work by Watching You
entry.summary: cotomi Act is a browser agent that executes multi-step tasks and turns observed user browsing into persistent knowledge shared with users.

entry.title: Cross-Interface Authorization for AI Computer-Use Agents
entry.summary: Presents a profile-bounded authorization protocol for computer-use agents working through GUIs, APIs, scripts, and other routes, with route-bound tickets and commit-time checks.

entry.title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
entry.summary: Introduces CUA-Master, a computer-use training framework that mines workflows from instructional videos and turns them into synthesized tasks and trajectories.

entry.title: CUA-Recovery: Benchmarking Error Recovery in Long-Horizon Computer-Use Agents
entry.summary: CUA-Recovery benchmarks error detection and recovery across desktop applications, using agent failures to create test states and training trajectories.

entry.title: CutVerse: A Compositional GUI Agents Benchmark for Media Post-Production Editing
entry.summary: Cutverse benchmarks GUI agents on long editing workflows across professional media applications and parses recordings and input logs into grounded action trajectories.

entry.title: Deep Search in Real-World Web Environments
entry.summary: OpenDS-World benchmarks multi-step research on the live open Web, requiring agents to search, interact with browsers and combine evidence across sources.

entry.title: Demo2Tutorial: From Human Experience to Multimodal Software Tutorials
entry.summary: Introduces Demo2Tutorial, which turns recorded software interactions into multimodal tutorials with task graphs and reports benefits for GUI-agent planning.

entry.title: Designing Agent-Ready Websites for AI Web Agents: A Framework for Machine Readability, Actionability, and Decision Reliability
entry.summary: Proposes an agent-ready website design framework for e-commerce browser agents and compares it with a human-oriented site on shopping tasks, outcomes, steps, and token use.

entry.title: DiagEval: Trajectory-Conditioned Diagnosis for Reliable Software Evaluation with GUI Agents
entry.summary: DiagEval diagnoses failed GUI-agent evaluations of interactive software by reusing failed trajectories for targeted probes that distinguish execution errors from defects.

entry.title: Diagnosing Personalization Failures in Mobile GUI Agents
entry.summary: PrefDiag-Bench diagnoses when and how user preferences should affect sequential mobile GUI agent actions, using staged probes and user context.

entry.title: DiffSpot: Can VLMs Spot Fine-Grained Visual Differences in Web Interfaces?
entry.summary: DiffSpot benchmarks detection of fine visual changes in rendered web interfaces using image pairs created by single-property CSS mutations.

entry.title: DocOps: A Verifiable Benchmark for Autonomous Agents in Complex Document Operations
entry.summary: Introduces DocOps, a verifiable benchmark for agents handling complex digital-document workflows, with analysis of state tracking, semantic checks, and structural edits.

entry.title: DRIVE: Modeling Skills at the Reasoning and Interaction Levels for Web Agents under Continual Learning
entry.summary: DRIVE separates reusable reasoning skills from page-specific interaction skills for web agents, retrieving both to plan tasks and execute actions on websites.

entry.title: DynaRev: Benchmarking Web Agents under Dynamic Goal Revision
entry.summary: Introduces DynaRev, a benchmark of 181 web-agent tasks whose goals change during execution, with trajectory-based measures of correctness, responsiveness, and efficiency.

entry.title: Enhancing Web Agents with a Hierarchical Memory Tree
entry.summary: Introduces Hierarchical Memory Tree (HMT), which organizes web-agent trajectories by intent, stage and action, then uses the hierarchy to plan and act on websites.

entry.title: EnvOS: Auditing Computer-Use Agents When the World Moves On : Phenomenon-Based Task Construction, Certification, and Evidence-Based Evaluation
entry.summary: Introduces EnvOS, a framework for constructing and auditing changing computer-use environments, including checks of task changes, solvability, grading, and run evidence.

entry.title: Evolving Agent Interfaces
entry.summary: Agent S4 uses task trajectories to evolve interfaces and usage guidance for a computer-use agent, selecting changes through validation tasks.

entry.title: EvoWeb: A Benchmark for Coding Agents on Evolving Web Applications
entry.summary: Introduces EvoWeb, a benchmark for coding agents that extend web applications through dependent requests; a multimodal web agent checks each version in a live browser.

entry.title: FinCUABuild: Can Agents Build Reliable Benchmarks for Dynamic Financial Computer Use?
entry.summary: Introduces FinCUABuildBench for assessing financial computer-use task construction and FinCUABuildAgent for generating tasks, environments, and validators.

entry.title: FineState-Bench: Benchmarking State-Conditioned Grounding for Fine-grained GUI State Setting
entry.summary: FineState-Bench tests whether GUI agents locate the intended control and set its exact state across desktop, web, and mobile interfaces, with stage-wise diagnostic metrics.

entry.title: FocusMem: Factorizing Content, Readout, and Trust in Latent GUI Memory
entry.summary: Introduces FocusMem, a latent memory interface for GUI agents that separates stored content, state-conditioned readout, and a gate for irrelevant retrieved experience.

entry.title: FormGym: Doing Paperwork with Agents
entry.summary: Introduces FormGym, a benchmark for filling image-only forms, and FieldFinder, a tool that helps LLMs locate where to place text on those forms.

entry.title: From Imitation to Discrimination: Progressive Curriculum Learning for Robust Web Navigation
entry.summary: Introduces the Triton dataset and a staged training curriculum for text-based web navigation agents, using hard-negative HTML examples to train element discrimination and longer task execution.

entry.title: From Interaction to Capability: Task Advancement as State and Supervision for GUI Agents
entry.summary: Introduces Task Advancement Memory (TAM) for long GUI workflows, tracking task progress across applications and learning reusable operations from interactions with local results.

entry.title: From Local Skills to Long-Horizon Web Tasks: Progressive Skill Exploration for LLM Web Agents
entry.summary: Introduces SCOPE, a training method for long web-agent tasks that discovers local skills from rollouts, composes them into chains, and expands them using failure experience.

entry.title: From Seeing to Reporting: A Theory of Reliable Visual Set Generation in Vision-Language Models
entry.summary: FSR models visual reporting and gives inference-time procedures for frozen vision-language models, including screen parsing and GUI target selection.

entry.title: fxBench: Evaluating and Understanding Formula Suggestions in Spreadsheets
entry.summary: Introduces fxBench, a benchmark of spreadsheet formula suggestions, and examines context selection, intent understanding and formula writing for editing assistance.

entry.title: GameWAM: A World Action Model for Video Games
entry.summary: Introduces GameWAM, a model for native game play and GUI control that predicts future visuals and keyboard-mouse actions from synchronized gameplay and GUI trajectories.

entry.title: GameWorld: Towards Standardized and Verifiable Evaluation of Multimodal Game Agents
entry.summary: Introduces GameWorld, a browser-game benchmark that evaluates multimodal agents through keyboard and mouse controls or semantic actions using outcome checks.

entry.title: Glasseek: A Transparent Recipe for Training and Trustworthy Evaluation of DeepSearch Agents
entry.summary: Introduces Glasseek, a framework for deep-search agents that explore the open web, with trajectory construction, training across context compression, and a test-set leakage audit.

entry.title: GTA: Generating Long-Horizon Tasks for Web Agents at Scale
entry.summary: GTA generates multi-hop web-agent tasks and executable trajectories through crawling, retrieval, and validation, releasing a benchmark built from over 50 websites.

entry.title: GUI-C$^2$: Coarse-to-Fine GUI Grounding via Difficulty-Aware Reinforcement Learning
entry.summary: Introduces GUI-D to score training samples by difficulty and GUI-C² to refine screen-element locations through area-gated cropping and reinforcement learning.

entry.title: GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents
entry.summary: Introduces GUI-JEPA, a mobile GUI policy that scores candidate actions from screenshot latents in a batched pass without decoding action text.

entry.title: GUI-Libra: Training Native GUI Agents to Reason and Act with Action-aware Supervision and Partially Verifiable RL
entry.summary: GUI-Libra trains GUI agents with action-aware supervision, a curated reasoning dataset and reinforcement learning adapted to partially verifiable actions across web and mobile tasks.

entry.title: GUIFlow: Temporal Redundancy-Aware Incremental Inference for GUI Agents
entry.summary: Introduces GUIFlow, an incremental inference framework that reuses visual, language, and action computation across successive GUI-agent steps.

entry.title: Harness Evolution Hits a Ceiling: When Weight Training Should Begin
entry.summary: Studies when to improve an LLM agent's runtime harness or train its weights by classifying failed trajectories; WebArena-Lite supplies a web-task transfer test.
